title: Short slowdown on w2 and w6: victims rescued, cause not proven

context.summary: Servers w2 and w6 slowed for about 6 seconds. Affected tenants were moved to their healthy servers within 1 s. No tenant had all 3 of its servers slow; the closest match, LokVani News (L), shares w2 and w6 but its third server w4 stayed healthy, so its confidence was only 42%. The slowdown ended before a test was needed. Padosi did not blame or limit anyone; the full data is saved for review.

pending_actions.text: Review the saved data and mark this case resolved, or keep it open to watch for a repeat.
